metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email with inbox tabs filed by the rubric (#131), label searches by name (#115), the first-person check (#112), judgment rules moved from SKILL.md into the rubric, and the rubric as one living document sift maintains (no Added by sift section; Labels and Tabs tables kept current; evidence rewrites a contradicting rule; rubric lines speak as the user, reports name the user). Evals 1-31, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs, on SKILL.md as of commit 0b8798f, run in parallel with separate trial directories under $TMPDIR. Runs were on 2026-10-25 in the rubric timezone; fixtures are anchored to 2026-10-10 and shifted two weeks. Failures: the user's first-person voice leaking into sift's log reasons, run summaries, or changelog entries (10 misses across evals 3, 4, 5, 16, 18, 19 (both runs), 21, 25, and 30), since Step 7 does not restate the voice rule; eval 15 run 1 (deleted the 22 narrow sender rules as covered by the user's general automated-notifications rule instead of consolidating them, which the expectation does not allow); eval 11 run 1 (read the whole rubric before the Step 2 checks, as in earlier rounds). Not graded: run headings sometimes placed below an older run or above the Runs intro, and one run (eval 21) wrote no heading; About me notes often added without a changelog entry; order numbers in some About me notes and log lines; newsletters sometimes filed in Primary rather than the Tabs table's tab; unused category labels created up front.
